note: First real run, October 2026: EPA AirData daily PM10 (8 monitors) and IEM ASOS hourly wind (IPL, TRM), 2023-2025. Run with the unmodified scripts 02, 04, 05 and 06 inside a browser (Pyodide), because the build machine could not reach EPA or IEM. Values transcribed from that run's output; per-monitor Brier/AUC beyond those listed were not kept. Rerun 02 -> 04 -> 05 -> 06 to regenerate the full files.
leave_one_monitor_out_note: Persistence had negative skill at every monitor. Calexico boosting AUC 0.741.
limits: Uses same-day observed wind, so it explains bad days rather than forecasting them.
Leave-one-monitor-out shares days with the training monitors, so it overstates skill at a truly new place.
Westerly wind does not prove a lakebed source; source attribution (RQ2) is still open.
Only one training year (68 bad monitor-days).
